notes: Read SKILL.md, references/capabilities.md and references/non-hero-scenarios.md in full. Reference for the azure-mgmt-botservice Python management SDK: create/get/list/update/delete Azure Bot Service resources, configure Teams/Direct Line/Web Chat channels, list channel keys, OAuth connection settings.

The only commands are `pip install azure-mgmt-botservice` and `pip install azure-identity` (lines 19-20), which is why the risk is medium; both are official packages. Everything else is sample code using DefaultAzureCredential with placeholder IDs (<your-app-id>, <oauth-client-secret>); the agent is not told to read, print, or send secrets.

Privacy note: the 'List Channel Keys' sample in SKILL.md line 263 prints Direct Line channel secret keys to stdout; the reference copy (references/non-hero-scenarios.md line 139) correctly says to use site.key without logging it. Users adapting SKILL.md should drop the print. Management samples create/delete bots and channels in the user's subscription only when the user's code runs.
